# DC-EPOXY

> Premium epoxy and resin flooring services in Dubai and the UAE.

## About
DC-EPOXY (Dubai Coatings) specializes in high-quality residential, commercial, and industrial epoxy flooring solutions across the United Arab Emirates.

- [Garage Epoxy](https://dc-epoxy.com/services)
- [Metallic Epoxy](https://dc-epoxy.com/services)
- [Flake Flooring](https://dc-epoxy.com/services)
- [Commercial Coating](https://dc-epoxy.com/services)
- [Industrial Flooring](https://dc-epoxy.com/services)
- [Healthcare Flooring](https://dc-epoxy.com/services)
